summary: Full editorial-crawl QA across /resources/articles after Batch 3 rewrite. Index renders a 4-col grid (gridTemplateColumns reported as '445px 445px 445px 445px'), 42 cards, result count '42 articles', 0/42 index card images broken (naturalWidth>0 for every card). Search ('invoice' -> 5), category filters (12 filters), and sort control all work. Crawled every one of the 42 detail pages: 42/42 render with H1 + article root data-testid, 0 pageerrors, 0 'Article not found', 0 broken images inside any <article>. Batch 3 (4 Wayly tool guides) all pass the editorial spec exactly: correct H1s, [data-testid=article-stepflow] ABSENT, no article-key-takeaways, no article-faq, [data-testid=article-next-step] present with correct primary CTA label + href (Explore the Contribution Estimator -> /ai-tools/contribution-estimator; Explore the Budget Calculator -> /ai-tools/budget-calculator; Explore the Provider Price Checker -> /ai-tools/provider-price-checker; Explore the Classification Self-Check -> /ai-tools/classification-self-check) and secondary 'Explore the 7-day trial' -> /pricing with the 'Card required. After 7 days, Solo is A$24.50...' disclosure; Sources render as real external links with no empty hrefs; related reading present; sticky lg TOC sidebar [data-testid=article-toc-sidebar] present on each. Pull-quotes verified: $8 on contribution-estimator, $1,200 on budget-calculator, $160 vs $95 on provider-price-checker; absent on classification (as spec'd). Section photos verified: [data-testid=section-use-the-checker-as-a-second-reader] on sah-invoice-checker contains a loaded [data-testid=article-section-image] (1880x1255); [data-testid=section-read-the-line-descriptions] on support-at-home-statement contains a loaded section image (1880x1253). Legacy slug redirect confirmed: /resources/articles/home-care-package-vs-support-at-home -> /resources/articles/what-happened-to-my-home-care-package. Two low-severity observations (not regressions introduced by Batch 3): (a) two related cards point to the legacy slug 'home-care-package-vs-support-at-home' which no longer exists in the index — the link still works because of the redirect, but the related card is not a canonical slug; (b) 11 legacy (non-rewritten) articles have no [data-testid=article-hero-image] on the detail page because they have no mapping in articleMedia.js — this is a pre-existing editorial gap, not caused by this batch.
